description: This file defines the UserNotificationPreferencesPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and update logic for user notification preferences within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering the preferences editing UI and processing user selections for notification methods.

classes.name: UserNotificationPreferencesPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class responsible for rendering and updating user notification preferences in OrchardCore.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the view model for editing user notification preferences, sorting available notification methods based on user preferences.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes the submitted user notification preferences, updating the methods and opt-out list accordingly.
